items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I picked him up in Ohio... and I would say maybe a season or a tour... Candy didn't work--I picked him up in Ohio

ctx.x: Not long. 1951 I think it was.
Since then Candy has visited me and he's married and doing fine. I think he's teaching.
I hope we have enough tape so we won't have to interrupt, one of the most interesting stories is the story of how "In The Mood" happened.
